verdict.rationale: Graphite lets an org enable AI reviews across the entire organization or only selected repositories. It also supports org-level AI review customization through custom rules and comment exclusions. That gives some centrally rolled-out review defaults, but the evidence covers only AI-review settings, and an org-wide AI block requires emailing support. Missing for 10: org-level human review policy defaults (required reviewers, approval rules), a documented per-repo exception/override model managed centrally, evidence of policy-as-code or bulk config for hundreds of repos, and independent or hands-on corroboration at scale.
